revoked.note: https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/chat.postMessage — invalid_auth (token_revoked, account_inactive and not_authed are the other credential errors); Slack answers HTTP 200 with ok:false

forbidden.note: https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/chat.postMessage — missing_scope; live answers also carry needed/provided, which the docs do not list

rateLimit.note: https://docs.slack.dev/apis/web-api/rate-limits — 429 with Retry-After; the docs show no body, ratelimited is the documented error string
